text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected in euc2 ingress cluster (5xx spike). Alert derived from edge-proxy 5xx-sla monitor. Paging oncall.

incident-bot: Summary: sudden surge of connection resets and 502/503 from Envoy to upstream in euc2. Traffic ~40% of normal but user-facing errors ~15%.

Alex T: I'm oncall, joining. Can someone paste quick metrics?

Priya S: attaching key graphs in thread (see infra dashboard). Not possible here but starting tail of envoy logs.

Priya S: Envoy logs showing repeated `connection reset by peer` to upstream pool for svc-ingress-backend. Example: `stream reset code=connection failure` every ~200ms for same backend IPs.

Kevin M: I'm checking ALB target health: target group tg-euc2-ingress reports 24/50 targets unhealthy, 502/5xx errors from targets. Health check failing with 504 occasionally.

Lina R: netops-bot ran traceroute to problematic AZ: packet loss spikes around euc2b border. Possible intra-AZ network flaps.

netops-bot: Automatic check results: BGP paths stable. Observed ECMP multipath imbalance on euc2b leafs, inducing TCP RSTs on long-lived keepalives.

Alex T: Customer impact: Support Team report increased timeout errors for admin APIs and web sockets dropping. Priority: degrade but partial; mobile clients retry.

Support Team: Noticing top-tier customers in EU region complaining about errors. Opening tickets and routing to oncall.

Priya S: Mitigation plan idea: 1) reduce ALB connection draining to force new connections to healthy AZs 2) adjust routing weight away from euc2b to euc1/euc3 3) apply temporary Envoy connection holdback to avoid hot resets.

Kevin M: Starting traffic weight shift. Executing: `redwood-routing set-weight --service ingress --region euc2 0.5` then gradual to 0.2 for euc2b. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: Rolling config change: `edge/traffic-split v12` applied to staging then PROD canary.

Priya S: Also increasing Envoy upstream keepalive timeout from 60s -> 15s on ingress to reduce stuck sockets: patch applied to euc2b. Command: ```kubectl -n ingress rollout restart ds/edge-proxy-euc2b```

Lina R: Confirming route53 TTL is 30s for weighted records; can be leveraged for quick failover.

Alex T: Quick connectivity test: `curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" https://euc2-edge-proxy.example | tail -n 20` shows repeated `recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)`.

Kevin M: After weight shift ~+10m: 5xx rate dropped from 15% -> 4% overall. euc2b contribution down from 60% of errors to 12%.

incident-bot: Note: paging escalation timer triggered at +10m, no paging further needed.

Priya S: Handing over to Kevin for next 30m stabilization window. Oncall handoff: Priya S -> Kevin M @ 03:20Z.

Kevin M: Taking lead. Running `aws elbv2 describe-target-health` and marking specific targets as draining where unhealthy. Also opening ticket with cloud provider for euc2b NIC flaps.

netops-bot: Provider ticket created: #CLOUD-92344 - 'euc2b leaf NIC error causing connection resets'. Provider indicates they are investigating host-level NIC metrics.

Lina R: As a precaution, spinning up extra ingress capacity in euc1 to absorb traffic: `k scale deployment ingress-edge --replicas=40 -n ingress-euc1`.

Kevin M: Noted a side effect: some customers still see session drops due to sticky cookies pointing at drained targets. Workaround: set cookie TTL to 10s temporarily. Patch applied.

Alex T: Monitoring charts now show request latency normalized; error rate trending down towards baseline. Will keep 0.2 euc2 weight for next 45m.

Support Team: Customer ticket update: "We're seeing reduced errors, customers reporting improved connectivity." ETA to close tickets TBD after stabilization.

Priya S: Quick mitigation summary for postmortem: traffic weighting, Envoy keepalive reduction, draining unhealthy targets, scaled euc1 capacity, cookie TTL adjustment.

Kevin M: Provider confirmed noisy NIC queue on euc2b and applied firmware microcode to a subset of hosts - helps but will monitor. They've scheduled a rolling host replacement window.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback not needed. All config changes stable.

incident-bot: Current status: degraded -> recovering. Continue monitoring for 2 hours.

Alex T: Creating follow-up ticket: INC-2026-728 - "euc2b networking flap -> ingress 5xx spike" assigned to eng-runtime + netops. Include timeline, commands, and customer impact.

Lina R: Suggestion for follow-up action items: add automated euc AZ weight fallback runbook, reduce default keepalive to 30s in ingress, and add cross-AZ sticky cookie eviction on drain.

Kevin M: Acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem write-up and coordinate with provider updates.

Priya S: Handed back to Alex for final closure. Alex T: closing loop?

Alex T: Will mark as resolved in 2h if metrics remain stable. Closing notes to support: notify customers of root cause (provider NIC) + our mitigations and next steps. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, error rate reduced to <1% above baseline. Monitoring window started.

Kevin M: Logging final diagnostics output to S3: `s3://redwood-incidents/3990004444/diagnostics.tar.gz`.

Alex T: Great work team. Follow-up postmortem and RCA requested.

incident-bot: Thread closed for now; reopen if errors spike above threshold.
